items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Right, Wendell. Now these are our children.

ctx.x: Right, Wendell. Now these are our children.

So now we come in the world with nothing; we go out with nothing. Wherever we could catch kids, instead of having a quart of whiskey on one arm and a chick on the other, we went and got these peoples and said, "Come on, it's out here." We couldn't play all 48 states. I said, "Alon, who are you studying with?" He had so many knots in his string we didn't know where to start, so we sent him to Mr. Gardner instead of George Stone.
